speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Respiratory Distress Syndrome (RDS)

The improvement in cyanosis with oxygen suggests a primary respiratory failure rather than a cardiac or metabolic cause, and the absence of feeding difficulties makes a urinary tract infection highly unlikely. I will proceed to request a Chest X-Ray and arterial blood gas analysis to confirm the diagnosis.
